overall_reason: The job is finding and adopting design guidance (Read mode): one left-aligned column on a single 170px edge, a hero that names what the system is with one "Get started" action, then the three entry points (Styles, Components, Patterns) and plain head-and-link sections for news, brand update, principles, community, support and roadmap.

score.reason: T-FIVE-SECOND, T-HEADINGS-READ and T-LEFT-EDGES pass cleanly (18 text blocks on one start line); T-ANATOMY finds the three main entry points placed under the news and email blocks, and T-JUDGE-TILE finds a thin closing section.

findings.where: "What's new" and "Get updates on the Design System" before "Styles / Components / Patterns", tiles 1440-00 to 1440-01, 1440px and 375px
findings.evidence: In dom-1440.json the h2 order is "What's new" (y=575), "Get updates on the Design System" (y=855), then "Styles", "Components", "Patterns" (y=1106). At 375 the three entry points start at y=1210, the second phone screen down.
findings.before: Release note and email sign-up between the hero and the three main entry points.
findings.after: Move the Styles, Components and Patterns row directly under the hero, and put "What's new" and the email sign-up after it.
findings.why: Most visitors come to browse components or patterns; the release note and the newsletter push the routes they need below the first screen at 1440 and 375.

findings.evidence: The last section is a 36px "Roadmap" head over one two-line sentence with one link, about 170px of content between a divider and the footer.
findings.before: A full section with its own h2 for one link.
findings.after: Merge the roadmap link into the "Community" or "Support" section, where the upcoming-components link already sits.
findings.why: The section is a head block with one line, and "Community" already links to upcoming work, so the visitor reads two places for the same plan.

strengths: Every heading and paragraph starts on one 170px edge at 1440 (the start-line count gives 18 blocks at x=168 and only the two Components and Patterns columns elsewhere), and at 375 everything starts at x=15.
The headings read alone outline the site: what it is, what's new, styles, components, patterns, brand update, principles, community, support, roadmap. None is a slogan.
The first screen answers what it is and what to do: the h1 "Design your service using GOV.UK styles, components and patterns" and "Get started" at y=451 to 494, inside the fold at every width.
The structure uses the system's own components (hero, section break dividers, plain link rows) and does nothing a Read page does not need.
not_investigated: T-STOCK-ORDER and T-COMPOSITION-RUN: a Read page, where composition variety does not apply.
words_per_screen (172 words on screen 3) and off_scale_spacing are sweep findings and are not repeated; 172 words is within what a Read page should carry.
